run_agent_population_evals: run agent population evaluations with a specified number of games and output directory
load_agent_mapping_config: load an agent mapping configuration from a prototxt or JSON file into CompareAgentPopulationMapping
compute_cross_elo_results: compute and print cross-elo results after agent population evaluations complete
get_default_output_dir: get the default output directory path for compare agents population results
setup_logging: setup logging using heyhi.setup_logging for the agent population comparison script
